## Partners

### Documentation

#### Documentation

#### API Reference

- [Partner Portal API Reference](https://bunny.net/docs/api-reference/partner/index.md): Manage your customers, pricing, products, and billing through the bunny.net Partner Portal API.

##### Customers

- [List Customers](https://bunny.net/docs/api-reference/partner/customers/list-customers.md): List the authenticated partner's assigned customers, newest assignment first.
- [Create Customer](https://bunny.net/docs/api-reference/partner/customers/create-customer.md): Create a new customer under the authenticated partner and email them a set-password welcome link.
- [Get Customer Overview](https://bunny.net/docs/api-reference/partner/customers/get-customer-overview.md): Get an overview of a customer: monthly usage snapshot, bandwidth trend, contract, and product summaries.
- [Get Partner Overview](https://bunny.net/docs/api-reference/partner/customers/get-partner-overview.md): Get an overview of the partner's own account in the same shape as a customer overview: monthly usage snapshot, bandwidth trend, and product resource counts. Contract fields are always empty and every product is enabled.
- [Invite Customer](https://bunny.net/docs/api-reference/partner/customers/invite-customer.md): Invite an existing bunny.net user to become a customer of the authenticated partner. An invitation email is sent, and the user is assigned once they accept while signed in.

##### Audit Log

- [Get Audit Log](https://bunny.net/docs/api-reference/partner/audit-log/get-audit-log.md): Get the audit log for one of the partner's customers. ResourceOwner identifies the customer each entry belongs to.

##### Contract

- [Get Contract](https://bunny.net/docs/api-reference/partner/contract/get-contract.md): Get the contract details for the authenticated partner.

##### Billing

- [Get Customer Billing](https://bunny.net/docs/api-reference/partner/billing/get-customer-billing.md): Get a billing summary for the customer's account, including invoice history.
- [Download Invoice PDF](https://bunny.net/docs/api-reference/partner/billing/download-invoice-pdf.md): Download the customer's invoice PDF for an existing billing record.

##### Pricing

- [Get Customer Pricing](https://bunny.net/docs/api-reference/partner/pricing/get-customer-pricing.md): Get the full pricing overview for a customer: effective prices versus list prices, custom overrides, and overrides expiring soon.
- [Get Partner Pricing](https://bunny.net/docs/api-reference/partner/pricing/get-partner-pricing.md): Get the full pricing overview for the authenticated partner: effective prices versus list prices, custom overrides, and overrides expiring soon.

##### Products

- [List Customer Products](https://bunny.net/docs/api-reference/partner/products/list-customer-products.md): List the customer's product enable/disable states, with resource counts per product.
- [Set Customer Product](https://bunny.net/docs/api-reference/partner/products/set-customer-product.md): Enable or disable a product on this partner-customer relationship.
